title: Answer: the self is a conscious automaton, and agency is a difference in brain states

statements.text: A human being is a conscious automaton, a part of the unbroken series of causes and effects, whose conscious states accompany that series. The difference between one's own actions and being moved by something else is kept, as a difference between brain states with different conscious effects.

sources.quote: none the less parts of the great series of causes and effects
Epiphenomenalism is also compatible with there being a distinction between actions that proceed from normal brain processes in normal conditions, and actions that proceed from manipulation by others
